title: Tokens of Motion: Primitive Motion Learning for Human-Humanoid Skill Transfer
source_discrepancy: arXiv abstract landing page incorrectly displays AFIL text; archived PDF and arXiv HTML identify M-PACT consistently. Summary follows PDF/full text.
supplement_status: 12-page PDF and public TeX archive contain no appendix despite references to it; demo repository contains website, images and videos only. Detailed supplementary implementation and ~100-demo result not independently verified.

release_status.value: Verified public demonstration website source and video entries, not model training code, checkpoints or full dataset release

evidence_boundaries: Hand/wrist manipulation primitives, not a whole-body joint tracker
Decoder reconstructs segment endpoint effects, not entire within-segment trajectories
Frozen representation reuse does not imply zero-shot contextual policy transfer
Robot prediction table measures translation labels only, without images or decoder execution
Robot translation errors use paper human-equivalent scaling
Real robot results are qualitative demonstrations, no trial-count success-rate comparison
Author demo webpage defaults to 4x playback and time-scales hand view to external view
